$description: Boxcode HRMS shared design tokens. Web consumes these as CSS custom properties in web/app/globals.css (:root dark for the sign-in page, .bx-light / .bx-dark for the dashboard). Mobile consumes them via mobile/src/theme.ts. Edit here first, then mirror - neither platform imports this file at runtime, because a JSON loader is not worth the coupling at two consumers.

typography.note: Web loads these via <link> (never next/font - it fetches at build time). Mobile uses the system font; the shared personality is weight and tracking, not the exact face.

motion.rule: Compositor-only properties (transform, opacity). Respect prefers-reduced-motion everywhere.

status.rule: Never colour alone. Every status renders a word plus a glyph.
